dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

The Pawdacity is at risk due to behavior concerns. During his time in the Care center, Pawdacity has been observed to high-pitch vocalizes (screeches) and pull towards the dog. The handler attempts to redirect him with a squeaker and calling his name, but Pawdacity doesn't look away from the dogs til they are out of sight. The Pawdacity has been observed to be doing kennel stress-related behaviors such as tracking a familiar handler as they walk in the room, hard barking, and high pitch vocalizing while pawing at kennel bars. He is noted to be social, wiggly when greeting handlers, and has enjoyed playgroup with well matched dogs. Medically, The Pawdacity has dermatitis and pyoderma.
dog.name: The Pawdacity
